top_signals.title: Stocks stumble on inflation fears, but 2 of our names give us reasons to stay bullish
top_signals.summary: Stocks came under pressure last week as surging oil prices and bond yields stoked renewed concerns about inflation and the Fed's next move.

top_signals.title: Iran attack on base in Jordan damaged American military aircraft, US official says

top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
